sources.title: OWASP ASVS 5.0
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Semgrep：以正負樣本驗證靜態規則
related.titleEn: Semgrep: validating static rules with positive and negative fixtures
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付版本化6項驗收矩陣、加權理由、失敗重現資料與修正後的回歸紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver six versioned acceptance rows, weighting rationale, failure fixtures and post-fix regression evidence.
related.difference: 為一條本機規則建立應命中、應不命中、巢狀與變數重新命名四類測試，再檢查誤報。
related.differenceEn: Build expected-match, expected-nonmatch, nested and renamed-variable fixtures for one local rule, then examine false positives.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 加權驗收分數=通過項權重總和/適用權重總和；權重是本課風險假設而非ASVS官方分數。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 選6個需求，權重3、3、2、2、1、1；前四項中第2項失敗，其餘5項通過。 總權重12，通過權重9，教學分數=9/12=75%。
Precision=TP/(TP+FP)，recall=TP/(TP+FN)；語法匹配不等於跨函式資料流證明。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 20個自編片段中8個應命中；規則找到6個真陽性並誤報3個，漏2個。 Precision=6/9=66.6667%，recall=6/8=75%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Weighted acceptance equals passed weight divided by applicable weight; these weights are teaching assumptions, not official ASVS scores. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Select six requirements weighted 3,3,2,2,1,1; only the second requirement fails. Total weight is 12 and passed weight 9, giving a teaching score of 75%.

Precision=TP/(TP+FP) and recall=TP/(TP+FN); syntax matching is not proof of interprocedural data flow. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of twenty original snippets, eight should match; the rule yields six true positives, three false positives and two false negatives. Precision=6/9=66.6667% and recall=6/8=75%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: in-toto：建置步驟材料與產物鏈
related.titleEn: in-toto: materials and products across build steps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付版本化6項驗收矩陣、加權理由、失敗重現資料與修正後的回歸紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver six versioned acceptance rows, weighting rationale, failure fixtures and post-fix regression evidence.
related.difference: 逐步記錄材料摘要、產物摘要與執行者，檢查前一步產物是否等於下一步材料。
related.differenceEn: Record materials, products and functionary for every step; check that upstream products equal downstream materials.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 加權驗收分數=通過項權重總和/適用權重總和；權重是本課風險假設而非ASVS官方分數。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 選6個需求，權重3、3、2、2、1、1；前四項中第2項失敗，其餘5項通過。 總權重12，通過權重9，教學分數=9/12=75%。
鏈結完整率=有完整摘要交接的邊/必要交接邊；每步存在紀錄仍可能在交接處斷鏈。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 四步流程有3條必要交接，只有2條摘要相符；封裝引用了另一版本測試產物。 完整率2/3=66.6667%；即使四步都標成功仍不能發布。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Weighted acceptance equals passed weight divided by applicable weight; these weights are teaching assumptions, not official ASVS scores. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Select six requirements weighted 3,3,2,2,1,1; only the second requirement fails. Total weight is 12 and passed weight 9, giving a teaching score of 75%.

Handoff completeness is evidenced edges divided by required edges; individual step records do not guarantee connected handoffs. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Four steps require three handoffs; only two match because packaging references a different tested product. Completeness is 2/3=66.6667%; four successful step labels still cannot justify release.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
